business_problem: As an industry-leading company, Sandvik Coromant needs access to data from all corners of the business.
solution_summary: Sandvik Coromant modernized its analytics estate on Power BI, Power Platform, Azure Databricks, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Operational, enterprise, or sensor data is ingested into a shared cloud store and transformed with Azure engineering services so teams can work from one current source of truth. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. Sandvik Coromant is one of the world's leading suppliers of tools, tooling solutions, and know-how for the metal working industry. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Transforms large-scale data and runs analytical or machine-learning workloads.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Runs integrated SQL and big-data analytics across enterprise datasets.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Factory
solution_components.role: Ingests and moves data from source systems into the analytical platform.

data_flow: Data flows from operational systems through Azure Data Factory into the platform data layer, where Azure Databricks prepares and enriches it; Power BI then exposes governed analytics and decision support to end users.
